name: EPIC 211987009
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 5, 10.1 solar radii and 0.81 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211987009 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM radius (solar radii) 10.101546 (16th-84th percentiles 9.900291-10.398353), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211987009 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM mass (solar masses) 0.810102 (16th-84th percentiles 0.774295-0.872626), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211987009: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4971.4565 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211987009 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 5638.671875 (16th-84th percentiles 5549.375-5746.328125), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.12 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 5,639 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 0.81 solar masses and 10.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,971 K at its surface.
